description: Player-facing data for the ReimaginedCraft Minecraft network: currencies, items, GUIs and systems, currently covering the Hub and Diamond Trophy servers.
scope_note: This is a first pass covering Hub + Diamond Trophy only. Other servers (Limbo, Elevator Chaos, the unreleased custom Rooms feature) are out of scope for now.
icon_convention: An entry or gui with a confirmed real in-game texture carries an "icon" field, a path relative to the repo root (e.g. "assets/icons/currencies/network-coins.png"). Everything else only has "icon_hint", a short text description of what the icon should look like for future art. No icon was invented or AI-generated - every "icon" field is a real texture from the live resource packs.
open_coverage_notes: Achievements and Quest Board entries are representative samples, not the full pool (50 achievements and dozens of quests exist; see each file's own notes for counts).
The in-game store (/store) and the real-money purchase flow for VIP/MVIP/Elite/Champion are not built yet - see ranks.json open_questions.
Off-hand cosmetics (Bouquet, Lantern, Plush) may not currently be equippable in-game - see cosmetics-altar.json open_questions.
Blueprint: Plush cannot currently be obtained by any active drop table (removed from the Rare Crate loot table pending the off-hand equip fix) - see hub-blueprints.json.
The Cosmetic Shard bag item has no live sink - no altar recipe currently consumes it - see hub-bag-items.json open_questions.
